item.description:
Nexa 1.0.5

  • The sidebar opens and closes cleanly: its buttons no longer disappear into a "»" menu for a moment, and it no longer opens halfway and then jumps.
  • The Tor status at the bottom of the chat list stays on one or two lines while Tor connects, instead of wrapping and jumping.
  • Short group chats sit at the bottom of the window, like one-to-one chats.
  • "Check for Updates" under a message that needs a newer Nexa now checks bauerhaus.io instead of opening the App Store.
  • Smaller fixes: group invitations and the Add People sheet read properly when lists are empty, file server details always open in Settings ▸ Relays, "Copied" turns back into "Copy Link", and a failed change to disappearing messages says so.
